corrections_to_v3_preliminary_interpreta.0.854_m_value: This was an apparent-fruit-size consistency residual in a rejected depth layer, not a measured base-to-wrist target-position disagreement.
corrections_to_v3_preliminary_interpreta.moveit_start_state: Fresh seed-44012 pre-hint, target-hint, and wrist-uncertainty runs did not reproduce a start-state-out-of-bounds diagnostic.
corrections_to_v3_preliminary_interpreta.evidence_rule: Only a terminal recorder receipt may prove a completed pick or batch; stage log reachability alone is insufficient.

changes.wrist_target_identity: The base-camera target pose is published as a bounded 3-D wrist hint. The wrist localizer accepts only a stable ripe track within 50 mm and republishes the base-owned track ID.
changes.fresh_stationary_tracking: Each target hint resets wrist-local camera tracks. The post-motion hint therefore requires the normal minimum observations to be rebuilt from stationary frames.
changes.fail_closed_confirmation: Wrist confirmations now reject invalid IDs, ID mismatches, non-finite measurements, excessive corrections, low confidence, and high uncertainty with stable reason codes.
changes.runtime_uncertainty: The wrist runtime applies a 0.5 bounded calibration to the geometry estimator's conservative size-residual uncertainty after all depth-layer rejection gates pass.
changes.frozen_evidence_boundary: Support-ranked near-tie preprocessing and runtime uncertainty calibration live in generalized_depth.py. The frozen localization core is restored byte-for-byte to its recorded 27119-byte SHA-256 binding.

seed_44012_pre_hint.finding: The wrist view could contain multiple accurately localized ripe fruits; choosing minimum uncertainty without the base target hint could select the wrong fruit identity.

seed_44012_target_hint.finding: Target identity remained bound to the base selection and the next fail-closed bottleneck was explicitly reported as WRIST_CONFIRMATION_REJECTED_HIGH_UNCERTAINTY.

seed_44012_wrist_uncertainty.finding: The fixes crossed wrist confirmation and reached guarded placement, but the recorder expired before a terminal action result. This proves deeper pipeline reachability, not a successful pick.

next_required_work: Make the development recorder and launch cleanup outlive the longest bounded manipulation action and always capture a terminal receipt.
Diagnose the long guarded-place execution and prove one complete perception-controlled development pick.
Complete one multi-fruit development batch without truth-assisted runtime decisions.
Run the 30 one-attempt formal scenarios only after the runtime gate passes.
